adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a new per-member view (`admin/views/group-member.js.es6` + `admin/templates/group_member.hbs`) and tries to apply it via `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}` in `admin/templates/group.hbs`. In Ember’s Handlebars `{{each}}`/collection view options, the conventional/recognized option is `itemViewClass` (not `itemView`), so if `itemView` is not supported it will be ignored and the new view/template won’t be used, breaking the intended member rendering.
